subject: maths
topic: Mensuration: plane shapes (perimeter, area, arc, sector)

kept.q: A circular plate has radius 14 cm. Using pi = 22/7, find the area of the plate.
kept.pidgin: Area of circle = pi r^2 = (22/7) x 14 x 14 = 616 cm^2.

kept.q: A sector of a circle has radius 21 cm and the angle at the centre is 60°. Using pi = 22/7, find the area of the sector.
kept.pidgin: Area of sector = (theta/360) x pi r^2 = (60/360) x (22/7) x 21 x 21 = 231 cm^2.

kept.q: An arc of a circle subtends an angle of 90° at the centre. If the radius of the circle is 7 cm, find the length of the arc. Take pi = 22/7.
kept.pidgin: Arc length = (theta/360) x 2 pi r = (90/360) x 44 = 11 cm.

kept.q: An arc of a circle of radius 7 cm has length 11 cm. Using pi = 22/7, find the angle (in degrees) which the arc subtends at the centre.
kept.explanation: Circumference = 2 pi r = 2 x (22/7) x 7 = 44 cm. The arc is 11/44 = 1/4 of the whole circle, so the angle = (1/4) x 360° = 90°.
kept.pidgin: Full circumference = 44 cm. Since arc na 11 cm, e be 1/4 of the circle, so angle = 1/4 x 360° = 90°.

kept.q: A triangular plot of land has sides 6 m, 8 m and 10 m. Find the area of the plot.
kept.explanation: Since 6^2 + 8^2 = 36 + 64 = 100 = 10^2, the triangle is right-angled with legs 6 m and 8 m. Area = 1/2 x base x height = 1/2 x 6 x 8 = 24 m^2.
kept.pidgin: Since 6^2 + 8^2 = 10^2, the triangle na right-angle triangle wey get legs 6 and 8. Area = 1/2 x 6 x 8 = 24 m^2.

q.q: A rectangular school garden in Enugu has length 15 cm and width 9 cm (on a scale drawing). Find the perimeter of the garden.
q.explanation: Perimeter of a rectangle = 2(length + width) = 2(15 + 9) = 2(24) = 48 cm.
q.pidgin: Perimeter of rectangle na 2 times (length + width) = 2(15+9) = 48 cm.
